name: m5-t8-weak-vs-kwu

variantDescriptions.weak: 8 independent compiles at once, today's `WeakHashSet` uniques table, every type interned
variantDescriptions.kwu: 8 independent compiles at once, `ChunkedInterner(weak = true)` and types made in the weak scopes not interned

description: 8 independent compiles at once (JMH `-t 8`, single shot: each iteration is 8 concurrent scala-corpus compiles, each its own `Global`), 24 GB G1 heap, laptop, separate forks, 3 per variant. Repeats the one-fork kperf contrast (jobs 576 and 574: 15,093 vs 13,208 ms per compile), where part of the gap was a JIT difference in `Typer.typed` between the two forks. Read GC pause sums from `gc.log` too. Build `claude/uniques-audit` `41986b33ea`.
